name: Peelable Ample Family with a Unique Corner
definition: The stored twelve-coordinate family is reconstructed from the certified 232-concept Hall contraction, its 62-concept overlap, and an owner coloring of the 3-supports. Its two sections have orders 89 and 205 and meet in the overlap.
parameters: It has 294 concepts, isometric dimension 12, and VC dimension three. Its unique corner is word 1894 with incident-support mask 2305, corresponding to coordinates $\{0,8,11\}$.
properties: The family is ample and corner-peelable. Its verified 294-step peeling starts $1894,1638,1634,1632$. Every peeling must start at 1894, so no peeling can be required to end at an arbitrary prescribed concept. None of the nine missing neighbors of 1894 is an ample addition. This shows that a unique corner does not imply nonpeelability; VC dimension three is the smallest dimension where prescribed-endpoint peeling can fail.
